Also "private hospitals" but that's a class.

(La Raza Medical Center, location, Mexico City). Also IMIM? Use relation "operator" or "owned by". We'll choose "operator" (subject: National Medical Center, relation: "operator", object: IMSS). Qualifier location Mexico City.
